p003-hba1c-series.text:
The user wants to know their HbA1c results and overall trend. I have three data points:

- 2024-04-10: 6.6%
- 2025-04-05: 6.1%
- 2026-03-31: 6.1%

So the trend is decreasing from 6.6% to 6.1%, with the most recent reading at 6.1%. Let me present this clearly.

I should note that these are the only three readings available. The values are in mmol/L? No, HbA1c is a percentage. Let me present the trend.

The change: from 6.6% to 6.1% is a decrease of 0.5 percentage points. The most recent reading is 6.1%, same as the second reading.

Let me present this in a clear format.
|你的糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）共记录了三次检查结果：

| 检查日期 | 糖化血红蛋白 |
|---------|------------|
| 2024-04-10 | 6.6% |
| 2025-04-05 | 6.1% |
| 2026-03-31 | 6.1% |

**总体变化**：糖化血红蛋白从 6.6% 降至 6.1%，下降了 0.5 个百分点，最近一次（2026-03-31）与 2025-04-05 的结果持平。趋势是向好的改善。

不过，糖化血红蛋白反映的是近 2-3 个月的平均血糖水平，间隔时间较长（两次检查相隔约一年），所以单次读数的波动可能受多种因素影响。如果你想更深入了解，可以告诉我你是否还有其他相关指标需要查看。[]
